messages:
rachel: Vendor Z is shipping Model v3 where the payload field 'response' is renamed to 'output' and embeddings length changes from 1536 -> 2048. This will break partner SDKs and marketplace adapters. Need a compatibility strategy.
aj: Oof. Do we have a list of partners hitting the v2 model endpoint? rough numbers?
tom: Quick counts: 5 partners calling v2 directly, 4 marketplace connectors, and ~6 SI customers using SDKs pinned to v2. Biggest risk: clients expecting embeddings length 1536.
anika: Proposal: two-pronged approach: 1) gateway compatibility proxy that rewrites 'output' -> 'response' and trims/pads embeddings when flagged; 2) SDK updates that surface a deprecation warning and helper to upconvert embeddings to 2048. Gateway path buys time.
rachel: Can the gateway safely pad/truncate embeddings without harming downstream apps? we should document how we pad (zeros) and warn about quality.
aj: We can add a per-partner routing flag: "model_v3_compat": true/false. Gateway will emit header "x-compat-model-v3" when active and metric "compat.model_v3_mapped".
tom: Marketplace actions: add manifest field "model_version_bridge": "v3" and list a migration doc, plus an opt-in toggle for partners to enable automatic mapping. Also surface a warning on the integration listing.
anika: SDK patch plan: bump SDK to show deprecation when requesting v2 model, add a helper method convertEmbeddingsV2toV3(emb) { /* pad or truncate */ } and example snippet.
rachel: Example client shim for field rename (to include in partner comms):

```javascript
// client-side shim: v3 -> v2 shape
if (resp.output && !resp.response) {
  resp.response = resp.output
}
// embeddings upconvert
if (resp.response && resp.response.embeddings) {
  const emb = resp.response.embeddings
  while (emb.length < 1536) emb.push(0) // pad for legacy behavior
  resp.response.embeddings = emb.slice(0, 1536)
}
```
Keep language-agnostic in advisory and link to SDK helpers.
aj: Timeline suggestion: enable gateway bridge guarded by per-partner flag immediately; announce 90-day migration; canary schedule: 3% for 48h -> 20% for 5 days -> 100%. After 90 days, remove bridge for non-opt-ins.
tom: Ops alerts: watch for sudden uptick in embedding size, memory pressure from padding, and downstream errors when clients assume 2048. Create runbook steps to disable mapping per-partner quickly.
anika: We'll add guidance: padding uses zeros, truncation is high-entropy cut (last dims removed) — document the caveats and quality risks. Offer hook for SI partners to get early migration support.
partner-bot: Partner advisory draft scheduled for 2025-09-02 14:00 UTC (status: draft).
rachel: Action items: aj -> routing flag + runbook + alerts; anika -> SDK helpers + deprecation warnings + PRs; tom -> marketplace manifest + listing banner + SI outreach; rachel -> coordinate vendor timeline, legal review of advisory copy.
aj: I'll post PR + runbook links when ready.
tom: I'll prepare marketplace opt-in toggle and add an "earlier access" checkbox for top partners.
anika: Implementing gateway rewrite behind flag and a short-lived metric "compat.v3_field_map". Will include a debug header "x-compat-debug" for partner logs.
rachel: Thanks team. Let's aim to have bridge + opt-in UI live before vendor ship. Will follow up in #partnerships-ops. :+1:
